package gateways

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"

	"example.test/gwapp/internal/domain"
	models "example.test/gwapp/internal/models/gateways"
	rules "example.test/gwapp/internal/rules/gateways"
	"example.test/gwapp/internal/scope"
)

// Create registers a pending gateway of the verified tenant and returns its
// one-time enrollment token.
func Create(
	ctx context.Context,
	e scope.Execution,
	ports CreatePorts,
	in models.NewGateway,
) (models.CreatedGateway, error) {
	if !rules.ValidName(in.Name) {
		return models.CreatedGateway{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: name", domain.ErrInvalidInput)
	}

	return ports.Registry.Create(ctx, e, in)
}
